title: fix(app-shell): Studio's remaining flow value slots write a literal or a CEL value envelope (objectui#12372)
body:
Fixes #12372
Clause-②: no

Studio stops inserting or prescribing the single-brace `{var}` token in the rest of the flow value slots the installed `@objectstack/spec` (`18.0.0-next.0`) refuses it in. This follows ADR-0032 Decision 2 (a value slot holds a CEL value envelope `{ dialect: 'cel', source }` or a literal) and Decision 3 (one delimiter; the single brace is deleted). It is the remainder of the per-site table in PR #12371 (objectui#12101), and it reuses that PR's mechanisms: the literal text cell with no picker, the expression cell that stores an envelope with a bare-reference picker, and the spec's refusal under a stored token. No new `refMode` or `valueMode` value is added.

## Measured first: per-site table on the installed spec

Instrument: `safeParse` of each node's config schema from `@objectstack/spec/automation` as installed (`18.0.0-next.0`), plus that node's row in `FLOW_NODE_EXPRESSION_PATHS`, the spec's path walk `resolveFlowNodeValueSlots`, and the two config judges (`flowNodeValueTemplateRefusals`, `flowNodeConfigRefusals`). Spellings tried: `{x}`, `{{ x }}`, a bare name, an envelope, a number, a string, a list, an object, a JSON string.

| Site | Spec row on next.0 | `{x}` | Prescribed spelling | Here |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| map `collection` | value | refused (`{{ x }}` and a bare name too) | envelope, or an inline array | **converted** |
| loop `collection`, loop with a `body` | value, `onlyWithKey: 'body'` | refused (a bare name too) | envelope, or an inline array | **converted** |
| loop `collection`, loop without a `body` | no row applies | not judged by any door | the bare name of a list variable (the legacy flat-graph executor) | **held, differs from the card's table** (below) |
| update / delete / get_record `filter` operands | value, `filterOperands` | refused | envelope or literal; a whole query placeholder such as `{today}` is accepted | **converted** |
| notify `sourceId` | value | refused | a string, or an envelope (a number is refused) | **converted** |
| notify `templateData.*` | value | refused | envelope or literal (only with `template`) | already converted online by PR #12371's map path; no offline field |
| http `body` | value | refused (a JSON **string** too) | envelope, or a literal (an object) | **converted** |
| screen `recordId` | value | refused | a string, or an envelope | **converted** (online only: the offline table has no field) |
| screen `fields[].defaultValue` | value | refused | envelope or literal | **nothing to convert**: no offline column; online it is a plain text input with no picker |

## What changed

- **A field whose whole value is one value slot** (`FlowNodeConfigField`). Which fields: the spec's own path walk, `resolveFlowNodeValueSlots`, asked of the node as it stands with a probe at the key. So the ledger's `onlyWithKey` is the spec's answer, and a served descriptor field gets the control too, whatever brace mode it carries. Such a field renders a text / expression toggle, the same one a value map row has:
  - the **text cell** is a literal with no reference picker. JSON that spells an object or a list is stored as that value, so an http body object and a collection's inline array are written as data. Other text is stored as typed.
  - the **expression cell** stores `{ dialect: 'cel', source }`, and its picker inserts the bare reference. A collection opens on the expression cell, since its literal is never a string.
  - under the field, the spec's refusal at that key, read from the two judges `registerFlow` and `objectstack validate` share. A stored `{account.id}` shows "Write `{account.id}` as { dialect: 'cel', source: 'account.id' }"; a collection holding a bare name shows the contract's refusal naming the envelope.
- **CRUD `filter`** (`FlowKeyValueField`, `FlowNodeConfigField`). The ledger's `filterOperands` row turns the map into a value map: the text cell is a literal with no picker, and the expression cell stores an envelope. A new `valueRefusal` prop lets the caller pass the spec's filter-operand judge (`valueSlotTemplateRefusals(value, { filterOperand: true })`) in place of the value-map rule, so `{today}` passes and `{recordId}` shows its CEL spelling.
- **Help text and placeholders** (`flow-node-config.ts`, zh in `i18n.ts`): the collection placeholders are `leadList` / `items`; the update_record filter help no longer reads "id → {recordId}"; the collection, filter, http body and notify sourceId help name "a literal, or a CEL expression". The get_record note on operator values (`{"$ne": null}`) stays: it is a JSON operator, not a token.
- The collection descriptors keep `kind: 'expression', refMode: 'template'`. Where the spec names the position a value slot, the inspector no longer reads that mode. What it still decides is how the designer's analysis passes (Problems panel, node-rename) read a stored string, which objectui#12329 owns. The `refMode` doc comment says so.

## Pins: `flowValueSlots-12372.test.tsx`

- The installed spec refuses `{x}` and `{{ x }}` at all ten sites, and accepts an envelope and the site's literal. A collection refuses a bare name, an http body refuses a JSON string, and a filter operand keeps `{today}`.
- map `collection`, loop `collection` (with a body), notify `sourceId`, http `body`: the expression picker writes `{ dialect: 'cel', source: 'customer' }`; a stored `{account.id}` shows the refusal with its CEL spelling and no picker; a stored envelope opens on the expression cell, clean. The map collection text cell writes an inline array; the http body text cell writes the object its JSON spells; toggling notify `sourceId` carries the text over.
- A body-less loop keeps the descriptor control. A served notify `sourceId` and screen `recordId` (plain strings in the descriptor) and a served collection marked `xExpression: 'template'` get the value-slot control.
- Each CRUD filter: the text cell has no picker, the expression picker writes an envelope, `{recordId}` is refused with its CEL spelling, and `{today}` with an operator object is clean.
- No help text or placeholder of the seven offline fields, en or zh, carries a `{var}` token (a pattern that also pins itself against `{"$ne": null}` and `{ "key": "value" }`).

**Ablation**, with the fix committed at `1831c45`: the four implementation files (`FlowNodeConfigField.tsx`, `FlowKeyValueField.tsx`, `flow-node-config.ts`, `i18n.ts`) were checked out from the base `df05784`, and the mutation was checked on disk (`isScalarValueSlot` count 0, `valueRefusal` count 0, the `'{leadList}'` placeholder count 1). Result: `Tests 27 failed | 19 passed (46)`. The 19 that stay green are the 13 spec measurements, the body-less loop pin, the pattern's self-check, and the help-text pins of the four sites whose help carried no token on base. Restore: `git checkout HEAD --` on the four files (absolute paths, in a trap); `git diff HEAD` empty, and each file's hash equals its `HEAD` blob.

## Verification

- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`, then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), at `1831c45`: both exit 0, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Every `FlowNodeInspector*` (with `loopItemVariable-9340`), `FlowKeyValueField*`, `FlowNodeConfigField*`, `flowTextSlots*`, `flowValueSlots*`, `VariableTextInput*`, `flow-node-config*`, `json-schema-to-fields*`, `FlowObjectListField*`, `FlowRecipientsField*`, `flow-value-envelope*`, `inspectorStrings*` and `notify-node*` file at `1831c45`: `Test Files 50 passed (50)`, `Tests 771 passed | 1 skipped (772)`.
- The full app-shell project (`pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/`) at `1831c45`: `Test Files 1338 passed | 1 skipped (1339)`, `Tests 12913 passed | 9 skipped (12922)`, exit 0.
- Gates, all exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `i18n-dead-keys`, `new-line-citations`, `control-bytes`, `changeset-claims`, `pending-changeset-literals`, `test-path-roots`, plus `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`.
- `check:spec-floors` exits 1 ("The scan collapsed: 0 package(s) declare @objectstack/spec …"). That is objectui#12334 on main and unrelated: this diff touches no `package.json`.
- eslint, narrowed to the 5 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files (`--no-inline-config --format json`): 5 files, 0 errors, 4 warnings, all `react-refresh/only-export-components` on `FlowKeyValueField.tsx`'s already-exported helpers (the same 4 PR #12371 reported). `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions` project, so type-aware linting is off, and this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.

## Acceptance notes

- **The body-less loop.** A `loop` without a `body` is the legacy flat-graph form. Its executor reads `collection` as the bare name of a list variable, and no door judges it (the ledger's `onlyWithKey: 'body'`). The designer palette seeds a loop without a body, so this is the common case. Its control is unchanged: an expression field whose picker inserts `{var}`, which that executor looks up as a variable whose name includes the braces (read in objectstack's `loop-node.ts` on its `main`; not run here). The card's table prescribes an envelope here, which this executor does not read, so the site is reported, not forced. The placeholder (`leadList`) and help now give the bare name for this form.
- **screen `fields[].defaultValue`.** Studio inserts and prescribes nothing there. The offline columns have no `defaultValue`, and a served descriptor's untyped `defaultValue` maps to a plain text column with no picker. That column shows a stored envelope as an empty box; this is not a `{var}` defect and is not touched here.
- **notify `templateData`** has no offline field. Online it is a `keyValue` map, already a value map through PR #12371's single code path.
- **Not touched, owned by objectui#12329:** the simulator's collection resolver (it reads a `{var}` string or a bare name, not an envelope), `json-schema-to-fields.ts`, and how the Problems panel and the node-rename pass read a stored collection string.
- A stored `{token}` is not rewritten automatically: the spec's refusal names the CEL spelling, and the author chooses (as in PR #12371).

objectui#12329 remains open for its own scope. objectui#12101 landed with PR #12371.

Changeset: `.changeset/12372-flow-value-slots-rest.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, minor).
